ROUTE: Lapwing-235B

This is a well-specified extraction/retrieval task: pull textual evidence supporting a specific claim. It has clear completion criteria (find and cite supporting passages), which is exactly the kind of task Lapwing self-reports as its top-rated family. Curlew holds a slight edge on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 79.2), but that gap is within the documented run-to-run variance threshold and should be treated as a tie on capability. Given comparable capability, I routed to the model whose self-reported preferences best match the task type—though note this preference is documented as dissociated from output quality, so the routing is essentially a tie-break in Lapwing's favor.
